### Why ATS and HRMS Integration Matters for Background Verification


Most Indian HR teams run background verification as a disconnected step. A candidate moves through the ATS (Zoho Recruit, Freshteam, Lever, Darwinbox) and then someone manually opens a separate BGV tool, re-enters the candidate’s details, waits for results, and updates the ATS. This manual handoff creates three problems.


**Problem 1: Data re-entry errors.** Typing candidate details from the ATS into a BGV tool introduces mistakes. A misspelled name or transposed PAN digit triggers a false negative, and the HR team chases a non-existent discrepancy while the real fraud goes undetected.


**Problem 2: Verification delays.** Manual workflows add 1-3 days between “offer accepted” and “BGV initiated.” During that gap, the candidate may join another company, or worse, start working before verification is complete.


**Problem 3: No single source of truth.** Verification results live in one tool while candidate records live in another. When an auditor asks for proof of screening, the HR team scrambles to match BGV reports with ATS records.


This blog ranks **8 background verification platforms by their ATS and HRMS integration capabilities** — from platforms with 15+ pre-built connectors to standalone tools that work alongside any HR stack without integration.


**What you will find in this blog:**


- A comparison table ranking all 8 platforms by integration depth
- Detailed review of each platform’s ATS/HRMS connectivity
- An integration compatibility matrix across 8 popular Indian HR tools
- When integrated BGV beats standalone (and when it does not)
- A decision framework based on your existing HR tech stack
- 10 FAQs answered

### 2. AuthBridge — Most ATS/HRMS Integrations Among Enterprise BGV Providers


**Pricing:** Rs. 1,500-3,000+ per candidate (annual contracts)


**ATS/HRMS Integrations:** Darwinbox, Keka, greytHR, SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle HCM, BambooHR, Taleo, and custom API for any HRMS


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Voter ID, DL, Aadhaar, UAN/EPFO, Passport, criminal (600+ courts), education, address, credit, global sanctions


**Strengths:**


- **Most pre-built Indian HRMS connectors:** AuthBridge’s integrations page lists Darwinbox, Keka, and greytHR — the three most popular Indian HRMS platforms. For enterprise HR teams already on these tools, AuthBridge offers the smoothest native integration.
- **Global HRMS support:** Connectors for SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, and Oracle HCM cover MNCs operating in India alongside global operations.
- **Automated candidate data flow:** When a candidate reaches the “BGV” stage in your ATS, AuthBridge automatically pulls their details and initiates verification. No manual data re-entry.
- **Status sync back to HRMS:** Verification results, risk flags, and report links are pushed back into your HRMS candidate record automatically.


**Limitations:**


- **2-6 weeks integration setup:** Even with pre-built connectors, AuthBridge integration requires sales onboarding, IT coordination, API key configuration, and testing. This is not a 5-minute toggle.
- **Enterprise pricing makes integration expensive:** At Rs. 1,500-3,000+ per candidate with annual contracts, the integration convenience comes with a 3-6x cost premium over SalaryBox Verify.
- **Integration does not speed up verification:** Even with a perfect Darwinbox-AuthBridge connection, criminal and education checks still take 24 hours to 7 days. The integration saves data-entry time, not verification time.
- **IT department involvement required:** Connecting AuthBridge to your HRMS typically needs IT department coordination for API keys, security review, and data flow approval.


**Best for:** Enterprises (200+ employees) already on Darwinbox, Keka, SAP, or Workday that process 50+ verifications per month and want automated data flow between their HRMS and BGV provider.


**Verdict:** AuthBridge has the most pre-built Indian HRMS integrations. But integration saves 3-5 minutes of data entry per candidate — not a game-changer when the verification itself takes days. For teams that value speed over integration, SalaryBox Verify delivers instant results at Rs. 499 with a 5-minute standalone workflow.


### 3. SpringVerify — Deepest Self-Serve ATS Integrations (Zoho, Freshteam, Lever)


**Pricing:** Rs. 799-1,599 per candidate (Basic, Standard, Premium tiers)


**ATS/HRMS Integrations:** Zoho Recruit, Freshteam (Freshworks), Lever, and custom webhook support


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Voter ID, DL, UAN/EPFO (reference-based), criminal records, education, address, reference checks


**Strengths:**


- **Self-serve integration setup:** Unlike AuthBridge (which requires IT involvement), SpringVerify’s ATS connections activate through simple dashboard toggles. An HR manager can connect Zoho Recruit in 5-10 minutes without developer help.
- **Trigger BGV from ATS:** When a candidate reaches a designated stage in Zoho Recruit or Freshteam, SpringVerify automatically creates a verification case. No manual tab-switching.
- **Status updates in ATS:** Verification progress (pending, in-progress, completed, flagged) syncs back to the ATS candidate card in real time.
- **Webhook support for custom flows:** For ATS platforms without pre-built connectors, SpringVerify offers webhook callbacks that developers can wire into any system.


**Limitations:**


- **Limited to 3-4 ATS platforms:** SpringVerify’s pre-built connectors cover Zoho Recruit, Freshteam, and Lever. If your team uses Darwinbox, Keka, greytHR, or any other Indian HRMS, you need the custom webhook (which requires a developer) or use SpringVerify standalone.
- **60-220% more expensive than SalaryBox Verify:** Integration convenience comes at Rs. 799-1,599 per candidate vs. SalaryBox Verify’s Rs. 499.
- **Integration does not make it instant:** Criminal and education checks still take 24-72 hours whether triggered from the ATS or manually. The integration saves the data-entry step, not the waiting time.
- **Zoho/Freshteam focus limits enterprise adoption:** Companies on SAP, Workday, or Darwinbox cannot use SpringVerify’s integration advantage.


**Best for:** Funded startups and SMBs already using Zoho Recruit or Freshteam that want one-click BGV triggering from their existing ATS without IT involvement.


**Verdict:** SpringVerify offers the best self-serve ATS integration experience — if you are on Zoho, Freshteam, or Lever. For teams on any other ATS (or no ATS at all), SalaryBox Verify’s standalone workflow at Rs. 499 is faster, cheaper, and works regardless of your tech stack.


### 4. HireRight — Global HRMS Integrations (Workday, SAP, Oracle)


**Pricing:** Rs. 2,000-5,000+ per candidate (global pricing; annual contracts)


**ATS/HRMS Integrations:** Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM/Taleo, iCIMS, Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters, BambooHR, ADP


**Checks Covered:** PAN, DL, Aadhaar, UAN/EPFO, Passport, international criminal, global education, right-to-work, sanctions screening


**Strengths:**


- **Deepest global HRMS integration ecosystem:** HireRight’s connector library covers Workday, SAP, Oracle, and other enterprise HRMS platforms used by MNCs. For companies running global HR systems, HireRight plugs in seamlessly.
- **Bi-directional data sync:** Candidate details flow from the HRMS to HireRight, and results flow back automatically, with status updates at every verification stage.
- **Multi-country verification in one integration:** A single HireRight connector handles BGV for India, US, UK, Singapore, and 200+ countries.


**Limitations:**


- **4-8 weeks integration setup:** HireRight’s enterprise integrations require dedicated project management, IT coordination, and testing.
- **Highest cost on this list:** Rs. 2,000-5,000+ per candidate makes HireRight 4-10x more expensive than SalaryBox Verify.
- **Slowest turnaround (3-10 days):** Even with automated data flow, verification results take 3-10 business days.
- **No Indian HRMS connectors:** HireRight does not offer pre-built integrations for Darwinbox, Keka, greytHR, or Zoho — the tools most Indian companies use.


**Best for:** MNCs using Workday, SAP, or Oracle HCM that need to verify employees across multiple countries under one integrated platform.


**Verdict:** HireRight leads in global HRMS integration but is irrelevant for India-only HR teams using Indian HRMS tools. For Indian companies, SalaryBox Verify’s standalone workflow at Rs. 499 is faster, cheaper, and works regardless of HRMS platform.


### 5. IDfy — API-First Platform for Custom HRMS Integration


**Pricing:** Custom enterprise (sales call required; estimated Rs. 5-15 per API call)


**ATS/HRMS Integrations:** Custom API integration only (no pre-built connectors)


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Voter ID, DL, Aadhaar (OKYC), UAN/EPFO (premium), Passport, AI document forensics, face-match


**Strengths:**


- **Flexible API for any HRMS:** IDfy’s REST APIs can be integrated into any ATS, HRMS, or custom hiring platform. For companies building their own HR tech, this flexibility is unmatched.
- **AI document forensics in the integration flow:** Embed AI-powered document verification (detecting tampered IDs) directly into your ATS workflow.
- **Enterprise compliance built-in:** SOC 2, ISO 27001 certified API responses include audit-ready metadata.


**Limitations:**


- **Developer required for every integration:** No pre-built connectors. Every HRMS connection is a custom development project.
- **Sales-led onboarding:** 1-4 weeks before you can even begin integration development.
- **High total integration cost:** API fees + developer time (40-80 hours at Rs. 500-2,000/hour) makes this the most expensive integration path for SMBs.
- **No self-serve option:** Cannot be used without developer resources.


**Best for:** Large enterprises with in-house development teams building custom HR tech stacks and wanting to embed AI-powered ID verification.


**Verdict:** IDfy offers the most flexible integration API with AI capabilities. For teams without developers, SalaryBox Verify’s standalone workflow delivers core ID checks at Rs. 499 without any integration work.


### 6. MployeChek — ATS/HRMS Integration With AI-Powered BGV


**Pricing:** Rs. 500-1,500 per candidate (varies by package)


**ATS/HRMS Integrations:** Keka, Darwinbox, greytHR, and custom API support


**Checks Covered:** PAN, DL, criminal records, education verification, address verification, employment history, AI-assisted document analysis


**Strengths:**


- **Indian HRMS focus:** MployeChek’s integration roadmap prioritises Indian HRMS platforms (Keka, Darwinbox, greytHR) — the tools 80% of Indian mid-market companies use.
- **AI-powered BGV workflow:** AI assists in document collection, data extraction, and anomaly detection within the integrated flow.
- **Guided integration setup:** MployeChek’s team assists with integration configuration, reducing the IT burden compared to pure API platforms.


**Limitations:**


- **Smaller integration ecosystem:** Fewer pre-built connectors than AuthBridge. If your ATS is not Keka, Darwinbox, or greytHR, you need the custom API.
- **1-2 weeks setup time:** Even with guided support, integration takes 1-2 weeks including testing.
- **Higher pricing than SalaryBox Verify:** Rs. 500-1,500 per candidate for integration convenience, when SalaryBox Verify delivers core ID checks at Rs. 499 standalone.
- **Limited self-serve experience:** Some plans require a sales conversation for integration activation.


**Best for:** Mid-size Indian companies (100-500 employees) on Keka or Darwinbox that want AI-powered BGV embedded in their existing HRMS workflow.


**Verdict:** MployeChek is a strong choice for Keka/Darwinbox users wanting native BGV integration. For teams not on these platforms or wanting instant results, SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 delivers faster verification without integration overhead.


### 7. OnGrid — API Integration for HR Tech and Staffing Platforms


**Pricing:** Rs. 250-500 per individual check (per-check pricing)


**ATS/HRMS Integrations:** Custom API integration; used by staffing platforms and HR tech companies as an embedded verification layer


**Checks Covered:** PAN, DL, UAN/EPFO employment history, criminal records, education, address verification


**Strengths:**


- **Built for HR tech embedding:** OnGrid’s APIs are designed for staffing platforms and HR tech companies that want to offer BGV as a feature within their own product.
- **Strong EPFO/UAN API:** OnGrid’s UAN-based employment verification API is among the most reliable for catching fake employment claims.
- **Per-check API pricing:** Granular pricing lets platforms offer different verification depths for different customer segments.


**Limitations:**


- **Developer-only integration:** No pre-built connectors for Zoho, Keka, Darwinbox, or any standard HR tool. Every integration is custom API work.
- **Not designed for direct HR use:** OnGrid’s integration model targets HR tech companies embedding verification into their platforms, not HR teams connecting their ATS.
- **Per-check costs add up:** Running PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO per candidate costs Rs. 1,000-2,000 through the API — vs. Rs. 499 for all four on SalaryBox Verify.


**Best for:** HR tech companies and staffing platforms that want to embed background verification as a feature within their own product using white-label APIs.


**Verdict:** OnGrid is an excellent BGV infrastructure provider for HR tech companies. For HR teams wanting to connect their own ATS/HRMS, SalaryBox Verify’s standalone approach at Rs. 499 is simpler and more cost-effective.


### 8. SurePass — Raw Government Database APIs for Building Custom Integrations


**Pricing:** Rs. 1-5 per API call (volume-based; free sandbox)


**ATS/HRMS Integrations:** None pre-built; raw APIs that developers use to build custom integrations from scratch


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Voter ID, DL, UAN/EPFO, Aadhaar (OKYC), Passport, GST, RC, MCA, bank account, 100+ government databases


**Strengths:**


- **Maximum integration flexibility:** SurePass provides the raw building blocks (100+ government database APIs) to build any verification workflow into any system.
- **Lowest per-call cost:** At Rs. 1-5 per API call, the marginal verification cost is the lowest on this list.
- **Instant API responses:** Results return in 1-5 seconds per query.


**Limitations:**


- **Highest total integration cost:** Building a SurePass-to-HRMS integration from scratch requires 80-200 developer hours (Rs. 40,000-4,00,000+), making it the most expensive integration path despite the cheapest per-call pricing.
- **No pre-built connectors for any ATS/HRMS:** Every integration is a custom development project.
- **No HR workflow or reporting:** Raw JSON responses require building your own reporting, dashboard, and candidate management layers.
- **Ongoing maintenance burden:** Custom integrations break when either the ATS/HRMS or SurePass updates their APIs. Your developer must maintain both sides.


**Best for:** Companies with dedicated engineering teams building custom HR platforms that need the widest possible government database API coverage.


**Verdict:** SurePass offers the most APIs and the cheapest per-call pricing. But the development investment makes it economical only for companies processing 500+ verifications per month with dedicated developers. For everyone else, SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 delivers the core checks without writing a single line of code.

#### FAQs: BGV Platform Integration With ATS and HRMS


###### 1. Which BGV platform has the most ATS/HRMS integrations?


AuthBridge has the most pre-built integrations among Indian BGV providers, covering Darwinbox, Keka, greytHR, SAP SuccessFactors, and Workday. HireRight leads for global HRMS platforms (Workday, SAP, Oracle). SpringVerify has the best self-serve integrations for startup-stage ATS tools (Zoho Recruit, Freshteam, Lever).


###### 2. Do I need ATS integration for background verification?


No. Integration saves 3-5 minutes of data entry per candidate but does not make verification faster or more accurate. SalaryBox Verify delivers instant government database results at Rs. 499 per candidate without any integration. For companies processing fewer than 100 verifications per month, the time spent setting up integration exceeds the time saved using it.


###### 3. Can SalaryBox Verify work with my existing ATS?


Yes. SalaryBox Verify works alongside any ATS or HRMS as a standalone tool. Open it in a browser tab, enter candidate details, get instant results, and upload the PDF report to your ATS candidate record. It works with Zoho, Freshteam, Darwinbox, Keka, greytHR, Workday, SAP, BambooHR, or no ATS at all.


###### 4. How long does it take to integrate a BGV tool with my HRMS?


Pre-built connector setup: SpringVerify takes 5-10 minutes (dashboard toggle). MployeChek takes 1-2 weeks (guided). AuthBridge takes 2-6 weeks (sales-led). HireRight takes 4-8 weeks (enterprise project). Custom API integration: 2-8 weeks depending on complexity and developer availability. SalaryBox Verify: 0 minutes (no integration needed).


###### 5. What happens to my BGV integration if I switch ATS tools?


If you switch from Zoho Recruit to Darwinbox, your SpringVerify integration breaks and must be reconfigured (or replaced, since SpringVerify has no Darwinbox connector). AuthBridge would need to set up a new Darwinbox connector. SalaryBox Verify continues working without any changes because it was never connected to your ATS in the first place.


###### 6. Does integration make background verification faster?


No. Integration speeds up data entry (3-5 minutes saved) but not the verification itself. AuthBridge still takes 24 hours to 7 days whether triggered from Darwinbox or manually. SpringVerify still takes 24-72 hours whether triggered from Zoho or manually. SalaryBox Verify returns instant results regardless of how you initiate the check.


###### 7. Can I use SalaryBox Verify alongside AuthBridge or SpringVerify?


Yes. Many companies use a layered approach: SalaryBox Verify (Rs. 499, instant, every hire) for immediate ID and employment verification, plus AuthBridge or SpringVerify (integrated with their HRMS) for criminal and education checks on sensitive roles. The two tools complement each other.


###### 8. Do I need a developer to set up BGV integrations?


For pre-built connectors (AuthBridge-Darwinbox, SpringVerify-Zoho): Usually no, but IT coordination may be needed for API key configuration. For custom API integrations (IDfy, OnGrid, SurePass): Yes, a developer is required. For SalaryBox Verify: No developer needed at any point.


###### 9. What is the cost of integrating a BGV tool with my ATS?


Pre-built connectors are typically free (included in the BGV subscription). Custom API integrations cost Rs. 20,000-4,00,000+ in developer hours depending on complexity. The ongoing maintenance cost (connector updates, bug fixes) is often overlooked and can add Rs. 5,000-50,000+ annually. SalaryBox Verify has zero integration cost.


###### 10. Which BGV integration approach is best for Indian SMBs?


For most Indian SMBs (fewer than 200 employees), the best approach is SalaryBox Verify as a standalone Layer 1 (Rs. 499, instant, works with any stack) plus a second tool for criminal/education checks only when needed. Integration becomes worthwhile at 100+ monthly verifications with a stable ATS platform and IT resources available for setup and maintenance.
